bridge-type.label: Direct-BT Bluetooth Adapter
bridge-type.description: A Bluetooth adapter driven directly via the Direct-BT userspace stack (no BlueZ daemon). Takes exclusive control of the adapter; bluetoothd must be disabled for that adapter.

parameter.name: address
parameter.label: Address
parameter.description: The Bluetooth address of the adapter in format XX:XX:XX:XX:XX:XX

parameter.name: backgroundDiscovery
parameter.label: Background Discovery
parameter.description: Whether this adapter performs background discovery of Bluetooth devices

parameter.name: inactiveDeviceCleanupInterval
parameter.label: Device Cleanup Interval
parameter.description: How often device cleanup is performed

parameter.name: inactiveDeviceCleanupThreshold
parameter.label: Device Cleanup Threshold
parameter.description: Timespan a device can remain radio silent before it is eligible for cleanup

parameter.name: scanIntervalSlots
parameter.label: LE Scan Interval (slots)
parameter.description: LE scan interval in 0.625 ms slots. Together with the scan window this sets the scan duty cycle (window/interval): the radio listens for the window out of every interval. Default 144 (90 ms).

parameter.name: scanWindowSlots
parameter.label: LE Scan Window (slots)
parameter.description: LE scan window in 0.625 ms slots. Default 24 (15 ms) = ~17% duty with the default interval. Raise toward the interval to discover weak/far advertisers faster, but beware: a near-100% duty scan starves connected devices' ACL slots and can drop their connections. Values above the interval are clamped to it.

parameter.name: scanDuplicateFilter
parameter.label: Scan Duplicate Filter
parameter.description: Controller-side duplicate advert filtering. Off (default): every advertisement is reported, so devices stay fresh and can be connected whenever their Thing becomes ready. On: each static-address device is reported only ONCE per scan session — a Thing that was not ready at that single moment never sees the device again until the scan restarts.
